// @version=5
indicator("Lucid 13 — Late-day long (15:00 -> 16:00)", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=50)

// =========================================================================
// CANDIDATE FUNDED LEG, NOT IN THE PLAN (night 2026-10-27/28; owner decides)
// USE A 5-MINUTE MNQ/NQ CHART. Rules as published for QQQ ("Quantified
// Strategies" screenshot sent by the owner 2026-10-27), tested on NQ:
//   1 yesterday's RTH close (16:00) < SMA50 of the RTH closes
//   2 today's RTH open (09:30) > yesterday's RTH close x (1 + 0.60%)
//   3 at 15:00 the close is above today's open
//   4 at 15:00 the close is in the top 23% of today's RTH range
//      (close - low) / (high - low) > 0.77
//   -> LONG at the close of the 14:55-15:00 bar, stop 1% below the entry
//      (filled at the worse of stop and bar open), exit at the 16:00 close.
// NQ 2010-2026, 5-min RTH bars (scripts/qqq_late_long.py, gross per trade):
//   +10.9 / +21.3 / +14.0 / +10.4 bp (2010-13 / 2014-17 / 2018-21 / 2022-25),
//   ~6.5 trades a year, 61% winners, the 1% stop never hit in 110 trades.
//   Weak since 2023 (-77 bp over 18 trades). No vol gate (the gated version
//   adds nothing - the signal lives on volatile downtrend days).
// Funded book at NQ 28,530 (scripts/late_long_book.py, open-P&L check):
//   + 3 MNQ adds +$1.8k / +$1.9k / +$0.3k / +$1.1k per seat over 24 months.
// =========================================================================

gapPct  = input.float(0.60, "Min gap up at the open (%)") / 100.0
rngMin  = input.float(0.77, "Min range position at 15:00")
stopPct = input.float(1.0, "Stop below entry (%)") / 100.0
smaLen  = input.int(50, "SMA length (RTH closes)")
cts     = input.int(3, "Contracts (MNQ)")
ptValue = input.float(2.0, "$ per point per contract (MNQ = 2, NQ = 20)")
showHist = input.bool(true, "Show historical trades")

etMin = hour(time, "America/New_York") * 60 + minute(time, "America/New_York")   // bar OPEN time
rthFlag = not na(time(timeframe.period, "0930-1600", "America/New_York"))
rthStart = rthFlag and not nz(rthFlag[1], false)
is5 = timeframe.period == "5"

// RTH closes (the close of the last bar inside 09:30-16:00) for the SMA, as in the backtest
var float[] closes = array.new_float()
var float lastRthClose = na
if rthFlag
    lastRthClose := close
var float prevClose = na
var float smaPrev = na
var float dOpen = na
var float dHi = na
var float dLo = na
if rthStart
    if not na(lastRthClose[1])
        array.push(closes, lastRthClose[1])
        if array.size(closes) > smaLen
            array.shift(closes)
    prevClose := lastRthClose[1]
    smaPrev := array.size(closes) == smaLen ? array.avg(closes) : na
    dOpen := open
    dHi := high
    dLo := low
else if rthFlag
    dHi := math.max(dHi, high)
    dLo := math.min(dLo, low)

// 2026-10-28: a 5-minute chart rarely holds 50 days of bars (free TradingView), so the
// in-chart RTH-close SMA can stay na; fall back to the daily SMA50 of the last completed
// session (settlement close, a small difference from the backtest's 16:00 close).
dSma50 = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", (ta.sma(close, 50))[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
smaUse = not na(smaPrev) ? smaPrev : dSma50
downtrend = not na(smaUse) and not na(prevClose) and prevClose < smaUse
gapUp = not na(prevClose) and dOpen > prevClose * (1 + gapPct)

var float lEntry = na
var float lStop = na
var int lBar = na

decide = is5 and rthFlag and etMin == 895 and barstate.isconfirmed and na(lEntry)
rngPos = dHi > dLo ? (close - dLo) / (dHi - dLo) : 0.0
goLong = decide and downtrend and gapUp and close > dOpen and rngPos > rngMin
if goLong
    lEntry := close
    lStop := close * (1 - stopPct)
    lBar := bar_index
    if showHist
        label.new(bar_index, low, "LATE LONG " + str.tostring(cts) + "\nstop " + str.tostring(lStop, format.mintick) + "\nrisk ~$" + str.tostring((close - lStop) * cts * ptValue, "#"), color=color.new(color.teal, 10), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.small)

if not na(lEntry) and bar_index > lBar
    exR = ""
    exP = 0.0
    if low <= lStop
        exR := "SL"
        exP := math.min(lStop, open)
    else if etMin >= 955 or not rthFlag
        exR := "16:00"
        exP := close
    if exR != ""
        pnl = (exP - lEntry) * cts * ptValue
        if showHist
            label.new(bar_index, exP, "LL " + exR + "\n" + (pnl >= 0 ? "+$" : "-$") + str.tostring(math.abs(pnl), "#"), color=pnl >= 0 ? color.new(color.green, 20) : color.new(color.red, 20), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.tiny)
        lEntry := na
        lStop := na

alertcondition(goLong, "Late-day LONG", "Lucid 13: late-day long at 15:00")

plot(rthFlag and downtrend and gapUp and etMin < 900 ? dLo + rngMin * (dHi - dLo) : na, "range 77% line", color=color.new(color.teal, 40), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(not na(lStop) ? lStop : na, "stop", color=color.new(color.red, 10), style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)

var table tb = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 2, border_width=1, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
if barstate.islast
    st = not is5 ? "LATE LONG: use a 5-minute chart" : not na(lEntry) ? "LONG " + str.tostring(lEntry, format.mintick) : na(smaUse) ? "SMA50: no data (scroll back / load more history)" : not downtrend ? "no setup: above SMA50 (" + str.tostring(smaUse, "#.##") + ")" : not gapUp ? "no setup: no gap up > " + str.tostring(gapPct * 100, "#.##") + "%" : "setup day - check at 15:00"
    table.cell(tb, 0, 0, "LUCID 13 · LATE LONG (candidate)", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.teal, 40))
    table.cell(tb, 0, 1, st, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=not na(lEntry) ? color.new(color.orange, 20) : color.new(color.gray, 50))
extra: ~6,5 obchodu ročně, slábne od 2023, bez vol filtru. Pravidla z tvého obrázku (QQQ).
